# Semrush fixtures for Phase 13 B

Hand-built from the v3 report documentation (research S6, S7; accessed 2026-10-13): semicolon-separated, header row of display names (`Domain`, `Organic Keywords`, `Organic Traffic`, `Common Keywords`, `Date`), CRLF line ends. Values are invented for example.com and placeholder competitors. Not confirmed until the live check: the `Date` header text of `domain_rank_history`.

Site Audit (Projects API v3, research S2 and S4): `projects.json` (list projects), `siteaudit-info.json` (`/siteaudit/info`; `current_snapshot.snapshot_id` and the `last_audit` unit are not confirmed), `siteaudit-meta-issues.json` (`/meta/issues`), `siteaudit-issue.json` (`/snapshot/{sid}/issue/{iid}`; the URL field name `source_url` is not confirmed).
